summary: CRITICAL: Print list is generic science-museum taxonomy and misses MSI’s real icons (U-505 Submarine, Science Storms, Idea Factory, Great Train Story, Fairy Castle, Henry Crown Space Center). No dinosaur hall; no Space Shuttle. Rebuild from griffinmsi.org/exhibits. Branding: Griffin MSI.
